title: Microsoft Teams Rooms on Android: Facilitator AI notes for in-person meetings
summary: The briefing passes: its licensing, default state, rollout dates and documented controls are supported. It correctly distinguishes the Android roadmap and tenant notice from Learn's preview and future-release wording. One minor table omission remains: the checklist asks administrators to check Facilitator enablement, but that control appears only in the prose.
